learn.canDo: Keep a fan-out to many services alive when a few are slow, with bulkheads, short timeouts, capped retries, load shedding and partial answers.
learn.why: Fan-outs fail together through the one thing they share. Spotting the shared pool and the multiplying retries is the core of resilience design.
learn.keyIdea: A shared pool turns a slow few into a dead many.

learn.canDo: Make a Postgres job queue safe in production with leases, idempotent handlers, attempt limits, dead letters and a table that stays small.
learn.why: A queue that claims correctly can still lose jobs, loop on bad ones and bloat. These are the failures that page you in the second month.
learn.keyIdea: Every claim needs an expiry, and every retry a limit.
